text: One bounded change groups input artifacts by exact release, decodes that immutable accepted release once per request and still validates every artifact after unchanged authorizeScopes. Snapshot pair qv2wMw -> bppwT6 passes all oracle cases:100x1 median7695.6->140.8ms;100x10019063.1->8640.7ms. Unchanged selection controls also improved, so host variation confounds raw speedup; repeating A/B and retaining all reports before making performance claims. Strengthened false-identity test includes valid+forged inputs sharing the same release.
